description: This file contains unit test code for the quic::test namespace, specifically testing the QuicUdpBatchWriter functionality, including socket creation, address support, and packet read/write validation.

classes.name: QuicUdpBatchWriterIOTestDelegate
classes.description: Abstract base class for delegate used in UDP batch writer tests, providing interface for skipping tests, resetting writers, and obtaining writer instances.

classes.name: QuicUdpBatchWriterIOTestParams
classes.description: Struct holding parameters for UDP batch writer tests, including delegate, address family, data size, and packet size.

classes.name: QuicUdpBatchWriterIOTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for parameterized UDP batch writer tests, providing setup, socket creation, and validation methods.

methods.name: IsAddressFamilySupported
methods.description: Checks if a given address family (AF_INET or AF_INET6) is supported by attempting to create a socket.

methods.name: CreateSocket
methods.description: Creates and binds a UDP socket for the specified address family and initializes the provided address and file descriptor.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs the test parameters as a formatted string.

methods.name: MakeQuicBatchWriterTestParams
methods.description: Generates a vector of test parameter sets for different address families, data sizes, and packet sizes.

methods.name: ShouldSkip
methods.description: Determines if the current test should be skipped based on system support and delegate conditions.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes sockets and addresses for testing, and resets the writer delegate.

methods.name: ValidateWrite
methods.description: Performs write operations to verify packet sending functionality.

methods.name: ValidateRead
methods.description: Performs read operations to verify packet receiving functionality.
